answer: Model peers as an artificial immune network where opal, cedar, and wharf are stake-bound validator cohorts; anomalous coordinated payloads raise suspicion, and each attestation multiplies consensus resistance by e^(lambda t) while zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs serialize challenge windows. Stake collateral C is bonded per cohort, slashing penalty S equals C for equivocation, and expected attack utility U=pV-(1-p)S-gamma C.
